_about: Bluetooth switch status -> verdict. Every reader of SwitchStatus.h (the switch web page, the DAQ Switches page) runs these. status is the 17 raw little-endian bytes, hex.

cases.name: armed, no battery
cases.text: Armed, but no battery is connected, so the load has no power.

cases.name: no battery outranks a live sense while disarmed
armed but sense reads open
cases.text: Armed, but no power is reaching the output. Check the battery; if it's fine, the switch may be faulty.

cases.name: armed but sense reads load
cases.text: Armed, but no power is reaching the output. Check the battery; if it's fine, the switch may be faulty.

cases.name: disarmed, load present (continuity can't see through the bridge board)
disarmed but live: stuck on
cases.text: Disarmed, but the output still has power. The switch may be stuck on.

cases.name: restored after reset, armed and live
